Face Cream for Men Daily Use: How to Choose and a 2-Minute Routine

By Mohammed Nihal, founderPublished 18 October 2026Updated 16 October 20266 min read
Quick answer

Men do best with a light, non-greasy face cream that suits their skin type, applied after washing and shaving, with sunscreen on top every morning. A simple routine in India is face wash, cream and sunscreen in the morning, and face wash plus cream at night.

  • A pea-sized amount of cream is enough for the face.
  • Choose a face cream by skin type, not by gender.
  • Apply cream after a cool rinse once you have shaved.
  • Mirc Glow creams do not contain SPF, so use separate sunscreen.

The best face cream for men daily use is a light, non-greasy moisturiser that matches your skin type, applied after washing and shaving, with sunscreen on top in the morning. Most men do not need many products. A gentle face wash, one good cream and sunscreen already cover the basics in Indian heat, pollution and humidity.

This guide explains how to choose a daily face cream, a simple skincare routine for men in India that takes about two minutes, how to fit it around shaving and a beard, and the common mistakes to skip.

Why men need a daily face cream

Men's skin is often a little thicker and oilier than women's, but it still loses water every day. Daily shaving, hot showers, bike rides in dust and sun, and long hours in AC all leave skin feeling tight, rough or dull. A daily cream helps skin feel comfortable, look smoother and cope better with shaving. It does not have to feel heavy or shiny if you pick the right texture.

Face cream for men daily use: how to choose

Your skinWhat to look forTexture
Oily, shiny by noonNiacinamide, light humectants such as glycerin or hyaluronic acidGel or very light cream
Dry or tight after shavingPlant oils such as avocado, aloe vera, glycerinLight to rich cream
CombinationNiacinamide, aloe veraLight cream; less on the T-zone
Sensitive, razor bumpsShort ingredient list, low fragrance, soothing ingredients like aloe vera or centellaLight cream
Tanned or uneven-lookingNiacinamide, kojic acid, vitamin C, plus daily sunscreenLight cream at night

Not sure of your type? Our guide on how to identify your skin type takes two minutes, or try our skin quiz.

A simple skincare routine for men in India

Morning (about 2 minutes)

  1. Wash. A mild face wash and lukewarm water. Rub for 20–30 seconds, rinse, pat dry.
  2. Shave if you need to (see the next section).
  3. Face cream. A pea-sized amount for the face, a little more if you include the neck.
  4. Sunscreen. SPF 30 or more, broad spectrum. A gel sunscreen suits oily skin. This is the step most men skip, and it matters most for tanning and an uneven look.

Night (about 1 minute)

  1. Wash off sweat, sunscreen and pollution.
  2. Night cream or the same face cream. A pea-sized amount, pressed in gently.

That is the whole routine. If you want a fuller evening plan, see our night cream for men guide.

Face cream and shaving

  • Shave after washing, when hair is softer, and shave in the direction of growth if you get bumps.
  • Use a sharp, clean blade. A blunt blade drags and irritates.
  • Rinse with cool water and pat dry; do not rub.
  • Wait a minute, then apply your face cream to calm the freshly shaved area.
  • Avoid creams with strong actives such as kojic acid on just-shaved skin if they sting. Use them at night instead.
  • Strong alcohol-based aftershaves can dry the skin; a cream is gentler.

What about a beard?

Skin under a beard still needs moisture. Work a small amount of cream into the skin with your fingertips, not just onto the hair. Wash the beard area properly at night, because sweat and dust collect there. If you use a beard oil, apply it after your face cream.

Common mistakes men make

  • Using body soap on the face. It is often too harsh and leaves skin tight.
  • Washing too often. Twice a day is enough; more can make oily skin oilier.
  • Too much cream. A pea-sized amount is enough for the face. More just feels greasy.
  • Skipping sunscreen. Especially if you ride a bike or work outdoors.
  • Giving up too soon. Skin renews roughly every 4–6 weeks. Give a new routine at least a month, and 8–12 weeks for a more even look.

If you have oily skin, our skincare routine for oily skin in India includes a section for men.

When to see a dermatologist

See a dermatologist if you have painful or cystic pimples, razor bumps that keep getting infected, a rash in the beard area, or patches that itch or scale and do not settle with a simple routine.

Skin brightening cream for men: what it honestly means

What "brightening" honestly means

Your natural skin tone is set by your genes. No cream changes it, and any jar that hints otherwise is selling a story. What daily life does is add a layer on top: tan from the sun, dullness from dehydration, dark marks from pimples or ingrown hairs, and a grey, tired look from late nights.

A brightening cream works on that layer. It helps skin hold water, helps reduce the look of dark marks over time, and gives the surface a more even, radiant look. That's a real and visible change. It's just slower and quieter than the ads suggest. Our guide to choosing a brightening face cream in India covers the ingredient side in more depth; this page is about what men specifically need.

Sunscreen is the real brightening step

This is the part most men skip, and it's the part that matters most. Sun exposure is a main reason faces look tanned, patchy and dull. A brightening cream can help skin look more even over 8 to 12 weeks, but if the sun adds a fresh layer every day, you'll barely notice. It's like mopping with the tap still running.

If you hate the feel of sunscreen, try a gel or fluid texture. They tend to feel close to nothing on oily skin. Put it on before you leave, including the ears and back of the neck if you ride. For sun-darkened skin specifically, see night cream for tanned skin.

For a glow-focused pick, see best face cream for glowing skin.

Short answers

Which face cream is good for men daily use? A light, non-greasy cream that matches your skin type, used after washing and shaving, with sunscreen in the morning.

What is a simple skincare routine for men in India? Face wash, face cream and sunscreen in the morning; face wash and a cream at night.

Can men use the same face cream as women? Yes. Choose by skin type, not by gender.

Should I apply face cream after shaving? Yes, after a cool rinse and a minute's wait, to help skin feel calm and comfortable.

Do men need sunscreen every day? Yes, especially if you commute by bike or work outdoors.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
